Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2001
PRISONERS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Prisoners Act, 1900
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 14th
November, 2001 ]
No. Legis.13-42/2001, dated 13-11-2001.--The following Ordinance
promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Prisoners (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 37 of Act III of 1900

ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2001
PRISONERS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Prisoners Act, 1900
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 14th
November, 2001 ]
No. Legis.13-42/2001, dated 13-11-2001.--The following Ordinance
promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information.
2. Amendment in section 37 of Act III of 1900.--In the said Act, in
the proviso of section 37 for the words "District Magistrate" the
words "Sessions Judge" shall be substituted.

Amendment in section 38 of Act III of 1900

ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2001
PRISONERS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Prisoners Act, 1900
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 14th
November, 2001 ]
No. Legis.13-42/2001, dated 13-11-2001.--The following Ordinance
promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information.
3. Amendment in section 38 of Act III of 1900.---In the said Act,
in section 38, for the words "District or Sub-divisional" the words
"Sessions Judge or" shall be substituted and for the word
"Magistrate" occurring for the second time the word "Court"
shall be substituted.

"Magistrate" occurring for the second time the word "Court"
